title: Claude review-code children skip the lens files and the freeze checks when the brief comes only through the slash command
outcome: Claude review-code children skip the lens files and the freeze checks when the brief comes only through the slash command
acceptance: A Claude /review-code child launched by /review-changes reads every reviewer lens file and runs the BEFORE and AFTER freeze checks, and its result names each lens with findings or none.
A test or recorded live run shows it on a frozen input.
